label: TP
reason: User input from HTTP header flows directly into an XPath expression used against XML documents. The defense mechanism (double Base64 encode/decode) is ineffective because it preserves the original content structure while changing representation, and the XML parser has DOCTYPE disabled but does not prevent XPath-based attacks via attribute names/values. The encoded payload still allows attackers to craft expressions that match or manipulate the document structure.

evidence.note: User input flows through decode/encode cycle then into XPath expression which is executed against XML document
